description: Early Grade 1, ~mid Term 1. Knows the five vowels and CV syllables for the consonants m, t, b, k, n, s, l. Has not yet learned any other single consonants, any digraphs, syllabic nasals, nasal/prenasalized onsets, or consonant+glide onsets. No sight words yet.

End of Grade 1. Knows all five vowels, all single consonants, and the digraphs ch and sh. Has not yet learned the remaining digraphs (ny, ng', dh, gh, th), syllabic nasals, nasal/prenasalized onsets, or consonant+glide onsets. Recognises a small set of high-frequency sight words.
